_note: Arena event tables. Manual-exact: practice's price (mirrors economy.services.arenaPractice), amateur-night's opponent count/kart count/cash reward, division-15's full row, city-championship's full row (cadence ties to cities.json championships.cadenceDays via @/sim/calendar's nextChampionshipDay). Everything an event lists under _reconstruction is a tunable seed, not a documented number - see fidelity-notes.yaml. Ids are neutral, no protected IP strings.

houseVehicle.name: Arena Kart
houseVehicle._note: Lightly armored, light-chassis/improved-suspension subcompact with one FRONT machine gun. 6 total = 5 amateur-night opponents + the player's own loaner, which is provisioned separately (see loanerVehicle) rather than being a sixth car off this row. House karts are never salvageable, win or lose.

loanerVehicle.name: House Loaner
loanerVehicle._note: The car the house lends a newcomer for amateur-night, provisioned MORE generously than the five arena karts it fields against them - the house wants a debut, not an execution. Deliberately NOT the houseVehicle row: amateur-night is one player against five simultaneous cars that all prefer the player as a target, so identical provisioning is a firing squad (measured: a stock kart dies around tick 152 and clearing the roster costs ~59 rounds against a 20-round magazine). Every number here is this recreation's own balance decision with no 1985 provenance, tuned to a measured win rate - see fidelity-notes.yaml. FOUR separate FRONT mounts, not one big magazine, because weapons.json caps a machine gun mount at ammoCapacity 20 and @/sim/construct rejects any mount over it; four mounts is how an 80-round allowance is expressed without breaking that cap.
